race.description: Sounds Of The Mountains Fm96.3 Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: TERESPRIT (8) has struck good form. She dominated her rivals here last start when storming home to win and then followed it up with another strong finishing burst at Wagga. Gets in well at the weights with the rise in grade, though she might land in a sticky spot from the inside draw. Watch for her bursting through late. SEGURO (4) recorded a gutsy maiden victory last time out over 1400m at Wagga, scoring by a neck. Winning rider Teaghan Martin sticks and he is right in the mix again. FLASHBACK TIME (9) has a moderate winning strike-rate but performed well last time at Canberra Acton, finishing fourth. At her top now and is worth including. LANG PARK (1) will find this easier and should be near his top now fourth-up. Bent's 2kg claim helps.
